t: What he told the women who asked for a day
a: مَا مِنْكُنَّ امْرَأَةٌ تُقَدِّمُ ثَلاَثَةً مِنْ وَلَدِهَا إِلاَّ كَانَ لَهَا حِجَابًا مِنَ النَّارِ
p: Mā minkunna-mraʾatun tuqaddimu thalāthatan min waladihā illā kāna lahā ḥijāban mina-n-nār
m: There is not one of you who sends ahead three of her children but that they are a screen for her from the Fire.
